tasks.goal: Add live worker progress without weakening completion semantics. Extend AgentStartInput with an optional onProgress callback and define a versioned WorkerProgressEvent for session.start, assistant, tool.start, tool.result, heartbeat, result, retry and error phases. Change the Claude adapter to invoke `--output-format stream-json --verbose`, parse complete JSONL records incrementally, derive bounded safe summaries, and still extract the final result record for exit/transient-retry logic; remain compatible with a plain single JSON result. Emit a heartbeat at a configurable interval while waiting for provider events and clear it on exit. Pass task/session context through runClosedLoop. When runCodexBatch has a runManifest, append each event immediately as one JSON line under .cliyard/worker-events/<runId>/<taskId>.jsonl, independent of RunManifest checkpoints. Extend supervisor status JSON with a read-only workerProgress array containing each task's latest valid event, age and stale flag, and print the newest human-readable event. Malformed or missing event files must not alter run status or accepted/verdict authority. Add focused tests using a fake stream-json provider that emits an early assistant/tool event, remains alive, and emits result later; prove events are visible before collect completes and supervisor status reads them without mutation. Preserve existing dry-run, transient retry, budget and result behavior.
nonGoals: No raw prompt, secret or full file-content logging
No change to accepted or verdict authority

tasks.goal: Run the implemented attempt continuity, worker progress and abnormal drill recovery paths against fresh measured evidence, inspect their output, and document only the observed results. Update README, NEXT_ITERATION, SUPERVISOR_V0 and RUNTIME_MANAGER; add docs/evidence/ATTEMPT_CONTINUITY_PROGRESS.md with exact commands, rejected-attempt worktree reuse, fresh-attempt behavior, live stream event examples, heartbeat/status behavior, timed-out drill recovery, final test counts and remaining limitations. Explain that default rejected retry reuses a recorded draft, --fresh-attempt deliberately discards it, stream events are observational only, and abnormal recovery uses exact reaper rules. Name Task Architect as the next capability and preserve daemon, cross-host, SQLite, browser evidence and admission scheduling as non-goals.
nonGoals: No source or test behavior changes
No automatic push or main merge
